ValidationRule.description: VR-QLI-04: Line Discount may only be set to 0% or 100% (or left blank). Fires only when Discount is changed, so legacy lines carrying other values (and Revise Quote clone-inserts of them) are not blocked unless the discount itself is edited.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Discount must be either 0% or 100%. Set 100% to waive this line in full, or 0% (or leave it blank) for no discount.
